gated.label: only when the regime gate allowed new entries

verdict: Every signal: 177 trades, 34.5% win rate, -0.1048R a trade, -18.54R in total, worst drawdown 35.06R. With the regime gate: 21 trades, 38.1% win rate, -0.0025R a trade, -0.05R in total, worst drawdown 4.90R. The gate improved expectancy by 0.1023R a trade on this window, and it did it by not trading on 52 of the sessions. Both arms lose money on this window, so the question of which gate is better comes second to the setup itself not having an edge here.
limits: Entry fills at the bar's close, stop and target fill AT the level. Real fills are worse, so real results are worse than these.
The universe is today's NIFTY list applied to a past window, so names that left the index are missing (survivorship).
No slippage, no partial fills, no queue position, no gap-through modelling.
One setup, one universe, 60 days. A single window is not evidence of an edge, and nothing here was tuned -- the parameters are the app's own defaults.
